description: This file sets up and runs a chatbot pipeline involving speech recognition, language model interaction, and external tool integrations, specifically for a GitHub-related assistant using Pipecat framework.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the chatbot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and management of the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with parameters and timeout.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs context with user parameters for aggregation.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the chatbot pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
